blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Navigated to Profiles Drilldown and explored all your services
- Broke a service down by its labels to isolate an anomaly
- Read a flame graph to see where a service spends its resources
- Compared two flame graphs with Diff flame graph to find the responsible function
- Optionally analyzed results with Assistant or flame graph AI

---
